parameters.query:
WITH a AS (
  SELECT id, telegram_id FROM athletes WHERE ($1 = '' OR telegram_id::text = $1) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
),
new_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM json_to_recordset($2::json) AS x(scheduled_date date, sport_type text, title text, description text, target_duration_mins int)
),
old AS (
  DELETE FROM workouts
  WHERE athlete_id = (SELECT id FROM a) AND scheduled_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND (SELECT count(*) FROM new_rows) > 0
  RETURNING gcal_event_id
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO workouts (athlete_id, scheduled_date, sport_type, title, description, target_duration_mins)
  SELECT (SELECT id FROM a), scheduled_date, sport_type, title, description, target_duration_mins FROM new_rows
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT telegram_id::text FROM a) AS telegram_id,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM ins) AS inserted,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM old) AS removed,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(gcal_event_id) FROM old WHERE gcal_event_id IS NOT NULL AND gcal_event_id <> ''), '[]'::json) AS old_gcal_ids;

parameters.jsCode:
const ids = $input.first().json.old_gcal_ids || [];
return ids.map(id => ({ json: { gcal_event_id: id } }));

## Import Plan
Reads the training plan calendar (default: الطريق إلى المراطون), replaces all workouts from today onward in Postgres, and removes the old plan events from the Darribni calendar. Called from Telegram: send the exported calendar file (.zip/.ics) or /import to read the Google Calendar directly.
